role_summary: Own group-wide IT resilience, service reliability, and platform modernization across FWD Group's infrastructure, cloud platforms, and core systems. Lead a federated SRE operating model, drive modernization roadmaps, govern resilience standards, and chair the Group Resilience Council.
must_have_requirements: 8–10+ years leading managers across multi-region operations

Proven track record leading enterprise resilience and modernization transformations including legacy remediation, cloud adoption, platform standardization, and operating model change in multinational environments
Budget ownership and vendor/commercial leadership; experience reporting to GMT on production risk
Deep expertise with multi-cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), Kubernetes, CI/CD, OpenTelemetry, and enterprise observability
Familiarity with ITIL 4, ISO 22301/27001, incident response (NIST 800-61), and audit frameworks relevant to insurance
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
nice_to_have_requirements: Understanding of IT operations in Insurance, BCP/DR, and regulatory expectations
soft_skills_priority: Stakeholder management across Group and Business Units
Excellent communication and executive presentation skills (fluent English)
Thought leadership and decision-making in technical strategy
Ability to foster blameless culture and continuous improvement
Leadership in building global SRE teams and running academy programs

scoring_criteria.name: SRE & Infrastructure Experience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core requirement: proven depth in large-scale SRE, platform engineering, and reliability practices.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Less than 15 years total or insufficient hands-on SRE maturity

scoring_criteria.name: Leadership & Team Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must lead managers across regions and build a global SRE organization.

scoring_criteria.name: Modernization & Transformation
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: JD emphasizes driving modernization of legacy systems and platform simplification.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: No evidence of enterprise modernization leadership

scoring_criteria.name: Cloud & Technical Expertise
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Deep multi-cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability required.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Missing one or more key technologies

scoring_criteria.name: Resilience & Disaster Recovery
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Direct accountability for DR tiers, exercises, and ensuring high availability.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: No specific resilience or DR ownership

scoring_criteria.name: Governance & Policy Creation
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must develop and enforce enterprise-wide SRE standards and release gates.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: No policy creation or enforcement experience

scoring_criteria.name: Communication & Stakeholder Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Regular reporting to GMT and Excos, plus cross-BU engagement.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Limited exposure to C-suite or multi-BU stakeholder management

scoring_criteria.name: Industry & Regulatory Knowledge
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Operates in regulated insurance environment; ITIL, ISO, NIST familiarity expected.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: No regulatory or insurance domain experience; lower weight so candidates from adjacent regulated industries can compensate

summary_focus: Senior SRE leader with 15+ years driving enterprise resilience, modernization, and reliability at scale across multi-cloud environments
Proven track record building and leading global SRE teams, defining SRE standards, and reporting to executive leadership on production risk
Deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability, and incident management frameworks
do_not_overclaim: Do not claim SRE transformation without concrete examples of legacy remediation or platform modernization
Do not claim multi-cloud expertise unless you have hands-on with at least two of AWS/Azure/GCP in production
Do not claim budget ownership without evidence of managing vendor budgets or P&L for platform teams

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Position yourself as a transformational SRE leader who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to build and govern reliability at scale across a global, regulated enterprise
bridge_gaps_honestly: If you lack direct insurance experience, emphasize transferable risk management and regulatory compliance from other industries (e.g., finance, healthcare)
If you have not led a modernization of legacy systems, highlight adjacent work like cloud migration or platform consolidation
If you have limited multi-region leadership, frame extensive global collaboration or remote team management
